name: Tanmoy Majumder
title: Coder, AI App Builder & Open Source Contributor
tagline: Building programming languages, privacy-first mobile apps, and technical tools from scratch.
elevatorPitch: I am Tanmoy Majumder (online alias Tcode-Motion) — a coder, AI app builder, and open source contributor from West Bengal, India. I specialize in Rust systems programming, Android mobile development (Kotlin & Flutter), and modern web architectures. I am the creator of TechScript (a plain-English programming language with a Rust compiler and bytecode VM) and developer of Android applications including KinotiX on Google Play and Satvora AI.
philosophy: Software should be fast, transparent, and grounded in understanding every layer — from lexers and bytecodes to native mobile runtimes and accessible user interfaces.
superpowers: Compiler Architecture: Creator of TechScript (custom Lexer, Parser, AST, Bytecode VM, and toolchain in Rust)
Android Development: Published KinotiX (4K Live & 3D Wallpaper) on Google Play and Satvora AI health scanner
Systems & Offline AI: Combining Rust FFI, ONNX runtime, and Flutter for offline neural processing in NeoSketch
Web Operating Systems: Architected NovOS with reactive window management and POSIX VFS over IndexedDB
Full-Stack & Open Source: 15+ repositories across Rust, TypeScript, Python, Kotlin, and Flutter
